notes.title: Samael's Prologue Demo
notes.content: A demo for the wicked minded and deceased.

notes.title: Dead Inside Studio AMA - Ask Me Anything
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

I'm very happy to participate in the Steam Games Festival, bringing out a brand new demo for the Prologue of Samael, my upcoming game, and an indirect sequel to the beloved Captive.

In this timespam, i'll be available to answer any questions about my work and talk about anything horror related through the Dead Inside Studio Group Chat here on Steam.

https://steamcommunity.com/groups/deadinsidestudio

Looking forward to meeting you.

notes.title: Samael in the Steam Game Festival 2020
notes.content:
I'm very glad to announce that a demo for Samael's Prologue will be available during the Steam Game Festival, and i'll also be attending to an AMA session at 6PM on Saturday, June 20th, to talk to you guys about everything related to my work.

Stay tuned, and looking forward to meeting you and checking your feedback on the game.

notes.title: Samael's store page is now live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, i'm very glad to say that Samael's store page is now live on Steam.

As some of you may know, this is the second game of my main storyline of horror games, taking place a day after Captive.

The game is still subject to many changes during it's development, which is very early right now, but you can check the synopsis and the main features planned for the game on it's store page, add it to your wishlist, and send me your feedback!

As always, thank you all for your support, and see you soon!
